paite: Mithilhihtheitak tate aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA kiang ah thupina leh hatna pia un.
heading: David La / Huihpi Lak A TOUPA AW
english: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah amin thupina pia unla; siangthou kilawmna silh in TOUPA bia un.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

paite: TOUPA aw tui tungte ah aging a; thupina Pathian ahong ging doldol a, TOUPA mah tui tampi tung ah aging hi.
english: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

paite: TOUPA aw thilhihtheitak ahi a; TOUPA aw thupitak ahi.
english: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.

paite: TOUPA aw in sidar singte ahihtan a; ahi, TOUPA'N Lebanon tang a sidar singte ahihtan lemlum zel hi.
english: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

paite: Bawngnou bang in amaute adiangsak a; Lebanon leh Sirion tangte gam bawngtalnou bang mai in.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

paite: TOUPA aw in meikuangte aphelh zel.
english: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

paite: TOUPA aw in gamdai sing aling a; TOUPA'N Kadesh gamdai alingsak zel hi.
english: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

paite: TOUPA aw in zukpite nou aneisak a, gammang singnahte anuaikeu vek hi; atempul ah, "Athupi e!" achi chiat zel uhi.
english: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

paite: Tuichim lai in kumpipa in TOUPA atu a, ahi, tangtawn a ding in kumpipa ding in TOUPA atu hi.
english: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

paite: TOUPA'N amite kiang ah hatna ape ding a, TOUPA'N amite khamuanna in avualzawl ding hi.
english: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
